items.information:
**Bem-vindos ao primeiro campeonato do Sudoeste do Paraná!**

🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [Guia para competidores novatos](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing).

Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. Competidores participando pela primeira vez devem apresentar um documento oficial que contenha foto, nome completo, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.

Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral na primeira rodada).

Após o término do prazo das inscrições, serão aceitas inscrições no local do campeonato apenas na modalidade 3x3x3, no valor de R$ 35,00. O Competidor deverá chegar com 30 minutos de antecedência e a inscrição só será aceita caso ainda haja vagas.

---

**Welcome to the first competition in the Southwest of the state of Paraná!**

🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, read this [Guide for newcomers](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing).

All competitors must present a valid photo ID at the check-in. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document containing a photo, full name, date of birth, and nationality.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

There will be awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for female competitors and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will be based on the ranking of the first round).

After the registration period ends, registrations will be accepted at the competition venue only for the 3x3x3 event, for BRL 35.00. Competitors must arrive 30 minutes in advance and registration will only be accepted if there are still registration slots available.

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaFavorites2025#63691-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

#Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition
Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most **five (5) events**.  If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaFavorites2025#64471-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab.  Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers.  Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap.  You can still register to compete in both events;  you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event.
